prerequisites: Basic knowledge of the general laws of rigid solid mechanics and their application to engineering problems.

learning_outcomes.text: Identify and quantify the different types of efforts, stresses, and deformations.
Dimension and verify simple mechanical elements.

syllabus_topics: Basic Concepts on Elasticity. Failure criteria
Simple efforts: stresses, deformations and diagrams.
Combined efforts: stresses, deformations and diagrams.

assessment_methods.method: Continuous Assessment grade (PLs and Controls) (Continuous Evaluation - Ordinary)
Half of Continuous Assessment grade (PLs, Controls) (Continuous Evaluation - Extraordinary)

assessment_rules: For Continuous Evaluation in the Ordinary Call: Final Grade = 0.80 * Exam Grade (out of 10) + Continuous Evaluation Grade. The Continuous Evaluation grade consists of 0.5 points from PLs (0.1 x 5 PLs) and two short theoretical-practical controls (2 x 0.75). For Continuous Evaluation in Extraordinary Calls: Final Grade = 0.90 * Exam Grade (out of 10) + 0.50 * Continuous Evaluation Grade. Differentiated Evaluation consists solely of a 100% written theoretical-practical face-to-face exam.
